limits: The synthetic 1.2-second writer lock plus 300 ms response delay makes the supplementary collector exceed the 250 ms affected-operation target. The complete polling RPC was not tested under that lock because other watched-repo and event-family writes are outside this slice.
Gateway elapsed time and serialized sizes are recorded; queue, SQL and clone time are not separately attributed.
Connector PR and review-thread adapters still use synchronous poll repository calls and are separate subsequent lane-A slices. No claim of whole-daemon main SQL absence or production deployment.
